first_broken_edge.finding: The adapter treats every current Hazard movement lease as safety preemption and treats absence of a Mechanic lease as lease expiry. Legacy pillar_bait_switch itself executes as a Hazard lease, so a new task starts suspended without a lease and remains suspended after its own legacy movement is submitted.
first_broken_edge.effect: The shadow task cannot reliably reach Running, the emitter can remain silent, and comparison can remain legacy_only. Authority cutover would therefore be unproven and potentially inert.

required_before_cutover: destination Z or typed floor divergence

errors: GitRevision::GetHash() is const char* but unchanged code calls size()
unchanged code calls an undeclared NowMs()

next_phase.objective: Repair the behavior-neutral task observation and equivalence contracts so one persistent transfer-lane episode can become Running, emit, and be compared without mistaking its own lease or lease absence for safety preemption.
next_phase.production_boundary: movement observation to persistent task state to shadow intent comparison diagnostics

required_invariants: an absent or expired short movement lease does not end or suspend the committed semantic task
a current same-scope movement lease matching the immutable task destination is recognized as the task's own execution even when legacy labels it Hazard
Recovery or a current mismatched Hazard destination suspends the task for safety
task progress remains based only on observed actor distance and never on proposal, selection, submission, or lease refresh
comparison never submits, arbitrates, executes, or mutates a native action
legacy Magmaw movement and combat behavior remains unchanged
all changed C and C++ files remain below 1000 physical lines

promotion_gate.required_evidence: One gate-off completion-watchdog observation capture containing a complete two-baiter task episode with Running emission, semantic distance progress, no ambiguous proposal set, and typed legacy comparison distributions.
